# Structural Literacy

Second chapter content goes here.

Figures work with plain Markdown image syntax — no raw LaTeX needed
(unlike captioned tables). Caption placement below the image is
Pandoc's normal default here, no override required the way tables
needed one.

![Placeholder logo, used throughout this book's title
page.](logo-placeholder.png){#fig-logo width="40%"}

As with tables, a `fig-` prefixed label makes a figure
cross-referenceable — @fig-logo above resolves automatically to
"Figure 3.1" and stays correct if figures get added or reordered.

To force a page break within a chapter (not needed between chapters —
that happens automatically), use:

{{< pagebreak >}}

Content after the break starts on a fresh page.
